Name: Alex Galbo
Description:
Alex Galbo is a dedicated Client Services Associate with seven years of experience in the finance industry, beginning his career as a Business Relationship Manager at Bank of America. Holding an Associate’s Degree from BMCC in Manhattan, a Business Administration Degree from Capella University, and an SIE certification, Alex is passionate about delivering exceptional client service, building strong relationships, and expanding his expertise in operations with the career objective of leading an operations team.

He supports advisors by managing tasks such as onboarding clients, opening brokerage accounts, transferring assets, handling money movements, and fulfilling required minimum distributions, allowing advisors to focus on strengthening client relationships. Outside of work, Alex is an avid traveler and self-proclaimed foodie, always eager to explore new restaurants and cuisines.

Name: Allen Buckley
Description:
Allen Buckley has over two decades of experience in finance serving the unique needs of high net-worth and ultra high net-worth families. As a Certified Financial Planner™, he specializes in helping clients achieve their financial goals, tailored to their individual circumstances and aspirations.

As a former Vice President in personal financial management at one of the world’s leading investment banks, Allen gained invaluable insights into managing wealth for discerning clients. During his tenure at Goldman Sachs, Allen worked with individual clients and families, helped them navigate complex financial landscapes and tailored financial solutions to their specific needs.

Beyond his professional pursuits, Allen finds joy in his family life alongside his wife, Crystal, and their children, Ella, Ava, and Luke. Together, they call Thompson’s Station, TN home and enjoy boating and various outdoor activities. His dedication to family, clients and his community define his career as a trusted advisor.

Name: Avi Claire Chabot
Description:
Avi Claire Chabot is a driven client service professional with a strong background in financial operations, relationship management, and high-touch client support. She brings more than five years of experience in the finance industry, where she developed strong skills in attention to detail, clear communication, and delivering a smooth, supportive client experience. She brings expertise in onboarding, operational workflows, and collaborative problem-solving, always aiming to make interactions efficient and seamless.

Avi Claire holds a Bachelor’s degree in Media Studies from the University of Colorado Boulder and has completed the Intuit Academy Bookkeeping Specialization, strengthening her foundation in accounting and financial operations. She combines her analytical skill set with a people-first mindset, striving to make complex processes feel approachable and to support others with patience and clarity.

Outside of work, Avi Claire lives in Denver with her boyfriend and their dog, Mowgli. She enjoys spending time with her family, traveling, photography and any activities that bring creativity and balance to her life.

Name: Cole Ferguson
Description: Cole is a Senior at Barrett, The Honors College at Arizona State University, where he studies Finance and Financial Planning. He currently serves as President of the Financial Management Association at ASU. Now in his second summer interning with Paragon PWM, Cole has developed a passion for building comprehensive financial plans and collaborating with advisors during client meetings where those plans come to life. Outside the office, Cole enjoys spending time with friends and family outdoors and catching a good sports game.

Name: Elena Schumakoff
Description: Elena serves as a Senior Client Service Associate, where she supports financial advisors in keeping client operations running smoothly and ensuring their clients receive a seamless, high-quality experience. She handles the behind-the-scenes work that makes it all possible: account administration, onboarding, and day-to-day support. With over seven years across financial services, client service, and operations, she's known for her attention to detail, professionalism, and commitment to building trust across every relationship. She holds a business degree from Saint Joseph's University in Philadelphia and is dedicated to continuous growth within the wealth management industry.

Name: Erica Luchetti
Description: Erica Luchetti, a Senior Client Service Associate, offers over 15 years of experience in operations and client service within the financial, music, and automotive industries. Her career began as a temporary receptionist in financial services, where her adaptability secured a permanent assistant role, igniting her professional growth. Erica excels at supporting financial advisors by overseeing daily operations, promptly addressing client needs, managing onboarding and account transfers, executing investment transactions, and ensuring accurate data. She collaborates seamlessly with external professionals, such as custodians, CPAs, and estate attorneys, while upholding rigorous compliance with policies and regulations. Driven by a passion for exceptional client experiences, Erica seeks to optimize workflows and cultivates trusted relationships. Beyond work, she treasures family moments, adores animals, dives into books, enjoys live music, and recharges by the water in the sunlight, maintaining her vibrant energy.

Name: Hillary Peterson
Description:
Hillary is the Client Service Operations Manager at Savvy Wealth, bringing nearly a decade of experience supporting clients in the wealth management industry. Since joining Savvy in September 2022, she has played a key role in streamlining service processes and guiding the client service team, helping ensure advisors and their clients receive consistent, high-touch support. Known for her meticulous precision and dedication to top-tier service, Hillary combines operational expertise with a people-first mindset to make day-to-day service feel seamless for advisors.

She is a graduate of Western Washington University and currently resides in Vancouver, WA, where she enjoys spending time with family and being outdoors.

Name: Kyra Luu
Description:
Kyra Luu is a dedicated Client Services Associate at Savvy Wealth, bringing 11 years of experience in banking and financial services, with five years specifically in wealth management. Beginning her career at Ameriprise as an Investment Service Specialist, Kyra has cultivated a deep expertise in operations, leveraging her comprehensive understanding of the industry to navigate challenges with adaptability and insight.

Kyra supports advisors by serving as their primary point of contact for client servicing, ensuring seamless operations through her meticulous handling of day-to-day tasks like money movements, account openings, and maintenance. Her problem-solving mindset drives her to tackle any challenge, ensuring advisors have the support they need to thrive.

Name: Lauren Kanipe
Description:
Lauren Kanipe is a dedicated financial services professional with over 3.5 years of experience, endeavoring to deliver exceptional client experiences through integrity, meticulous attention to detail, and outstanding communication skills. She began her career at Merrill Lynch in Charleston, SC, where she honed her ability to build meaningful relationships and target results.

Holding a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration from The University of South Carolina and a Securities Industry Essentials (SIE) certification, Lauren combines her educational foundation with a passion for helping others. She aims to provide white-glove service, working closely with advisors and their clients to simplify processes and ensure seamless, high-quality support.

Professionally, Lauren is driven by her commitment to making a positive impact in the lives of others. Personally, she values family and cherishes opportunities to foster strong, meaningful connections. Her client-centric approach and dedication to excellence make her an invaluable asset to her team and clients alike.

Name: Lyndsy Skiest
Description:
Lyndsy is a seasoned financial services professional with over a decade of industry experience, dedicated to delivering exceptional white-glove service to high-net-worth clients. Known for her keen eye for efficiency, she excels at streamlining processes and simplifying complex operations—keeping everyone informed and moving toward results with speed and precision. Her client-centric approach and drive for success make her an invaluable partner for both clients and team members alike.

With a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration and the Financial Paraplanner Qualified Professional (FPQP) designation, Lyndsy brings both education and expertise to her work. Throughout her career as a Client Service Specialist and Operations Specialist at multiple RIAs across the country, she has honed her ability to manage relationships, drive operational excellence, and ensure seamless, high-quality support at every touchpoint.

Outside the office, Lyndsy is a proud dog mom who cherishes quality time with family and friends. She's an avid traveler and hiking enthusiast, passionate about exploring new restaurants, and loves nothing more than relaxing at the beach.

Name: Miranda Petersen
Description:
I’m a Client Service Associate with three years of industry experience, focused on delivering thoughtful, detail-driven support to both clients and advisors. I’m a proud Purdue University graduate and hold my Series 7 and SIE licenses, giving me a strong foundation in both service and securities.
Originally from Atlanta, I recently traded peaches for palm trees and now call Orlando home. When I’m not supporting clients, you can usually find me spending time with my fiancé, Bailey, and our two dogs cheering on some football games!

Name: Parker Howard
Description:
Parker, born and raised in Phoenix, Arizona, now lives in Buckeye, AZ. He earned a Bachelor of Science in Finance & Economics from Grand Canyon University and holds Series 7, 63, and 65 certifications. As a Client Service Associate, he brings a strong foundation in finance and client service expertise.

With five years of broker-dealer experience, Parker has honed skills in relationship building, advisor support, and client service. Since joining Savvy, Parker has focused on exceptional client service and streamlining new business onboarding.

His professional approach centers on proactive problem-solving, clear communication, and precise execution. Outside work, Parker values family, faith, and cheering for Arizona sports teams.

Name: Sara Lopez
Description:
Sara Lopez brings over 15 years of invaluable experience in the financial industry to her role as Relationship Manager at Paragon’s Modesto office, with her most recent four years spent at Goldman Sachs. With a background that began as a Teller and Personal Banker and evolved into a Sales and Service Manager at Goldman Sachs, Sara deeply understands client needs and financial processes.
In her current position, Sara plays a pivotal role in establishing and nurturing new client relationships. She guides clients seamlessly through the onboarding process, ensuring all necessary paperwork is completed while serving as a trusted resource for any inquiries.

Outside of her professional endeavors, Sara has proudly called Modesto home for the past decade, sharing her life with her partner of five years, Jon, and his two wonderful children. She’s an avid traveler, enjoys visits to Disneyland, and possesses a passion for culinary pursuits. During her leisure time, you’ll often find her engrossed in a good book, indulging in movies and TV shows, or hosting gatherings with friends and family.

Name: Tanya Bustillos
Description:
Tanya is a Senior Operations Manager for Universal Value Advisors. As a loyal employee of nearly 10 years, Tanya is responsible for processing accounts, office management, and fulfilling client requests. Working so intimately with clients, she has enjoyed learning from them both professionally and personally. Beyond finance, her career has traversed many fields, which allowed Tanya to adapt quickly to new industries and make an impact.

Tanya holds of Bachelor’s Degree in Sociology from Sonoma State University.


Ancora West Advisors, LLC dba Universal Value Advisors (“UVA”) is an investment advisor firm registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission. Savvy Advisors, Inc. (“Savvy Advisors”) is also an investment advisor firm registered with the SEC. UVA and Savvy are not affiliated or related.

Name: Wade Montgomery
Description: Wade is a dedicated financial services professional with more than 12 years of experience across banks, Independent Marketing Organizations (IMO)s, insurance carriers, broker‑dealers, and the investment advisory space. A graduate of Ball State University and holder of the Series 7 and 63 licenses, he brings a broad industry perspective and a strong commitment to operational excellence. Wade is driven by building strong partnerships, maintaining clear and consistent communication, and delivering a high‑quality experience for advisors.
